title: Kubernetes Migration
imgAlt: Diagram: a legacy monolith migrated to pods across a Kubernetes cluster, deployed by Argo CD from Git
desc: Broke monolithic apps into services and moved them onto Kubernetes, with Argo CD deploying straight from Git. Deployments got about 40% faster.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Automation
imgAlt: Diagram: CI/CD pipeline stages commit, build, test, scan, deploy and monitor, with a feedback loop
desc: Jenkins and GitLab CI pipelines that build, test and run security scans on every change. Deployments that used to take hours now take minutes.

title: AWS Infrastructure Automation
imgAlt: Diagram: Terraform code applied to an AWS region with a VPC spanning two availability zones
desc: Wrote Terraform for our AWS setup, from VPCs to databases. A new environment went from days of manual work to a few minutes.

title: SRE Implementation
imgAlt: Dashboard: 99.9% availability SLO, p99 latency under target, error budget and alerts
desc: Set up SLOs, Prometheus and Grafana dashboards and alerting that catches problems before users do. Uptime has held at 99.9%.

title: Full Stack Web Applications
imgAlt: Diagram: three-tier web application with a Next.js frontend, Node.js API and MongoDB/PostgreSQL data layer
desc: I also build web apps end to end: Next.js and React on the front, Node.js and a real database behind it, shipped through CI/CD. This site is one of them.

title: Azure DevOps Platform
imgAlt: Diagram: Azure DevOps Boards, Repos, Pipelines and Artifacts feeding a release to dev, staging and an approval-gated prod
desc: Rolled out Azure DevOps across the whole delivery flow: Boards for planning, Repos with branch policies, multi-stage YAML pipelines and gated releases to production.
